data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the Radar geofencing and location tracking platform
data.what_it_does: The Radar SDK abstracts cross-platform location services to add geofencing, location tracking, trip tracking, geocoding, and search to your app. It provides methods for tracking user locations and managing background tracking options.
use_when: You need to implement geofencing or trip tracking in your app
You use the Radar location platform for telemetry or maps
avoid_when: You want a fully local, self-managed geolocator without third-party platform dependencies
You only need basic device location coordinates without cloud-backed geofencing or search
strengths: Abstracts cross-platform differences between location services
Supports advanced features like trip tracking, geocoding, and verified location tokens
weaknesses: Depends on an external proprietary platform (Radar)
Not documented details on manual native setup steps beyond platform mentions
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration for Android and iOS location services as outlined in Radar's documentation.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a standard, platform-agnostic location plugin rather than a specific commercial backend service like Radar.
